answer: Stop sybils with echo replication. First, each newcomer's first fifty jobs are re-run by three unrelated established agents. Second, a job earns credit only when at least two echoes match the original result exactly; mismatches trigger review. Third, two failed echoes revoke the account and burn its deposit, so fakes cannot retry cheaply. Forging ten thousand identities would need five hundred thousand replicated jobs and one million five hundred thousand verifier-hours, over $4 million. Like pigment settling into a reef, only echoed work leaves a lasting mark; the rest washes away.
